stories.title: stories
stories.count: conversations with twenty-somethings · more every two weeks
stories.intro: filmed conversations with people in their twenties. not the version where everything worked out — the one where they're still in it. what they're doing, what they're not saying, and the question they'd ask the next person.
stories.note: honest bit: the first few weren't conversations yet. i was too scared to ask strangers to talk, so i handed them my notebook and asked for one piece of advice for someone in their twenties. that was version one. zack was the first time i actually sat down and talked.
stories.empty: the cuts aren't up yet. the first ones go out in november.

strategies.title: strategies
strategies.count: the newsletter · at least one email every two weeks
strategies.intro: the written side of fomties. what i'm thinking, what i'm building, and what people say when the camera's off.

kinds.v: what i'm working through that fortnight. the honest version, in writing.
what it's actually taking to build fomties — the asks, the no's, the stuff that didn't work.
the uncut side. what someone said that didn't make the cut, and what i'm still thinking about.

strategies.promise: every issue is some mix of those three. no roundups of things you didn't ask for. no selling. if an issue isn't worth your five minutes, it doesn't get sent.

systems.title: systems
systems.count: tools and frameworks · built from the conversations
systems.intro: everything here comes out of a real conversation and years of actually using it. if it's on this page, it's been tested in the middle of not knowing.

items.v: the digital version of the paper journal i've kept for the last three, four years. five minutes a day, nothing clever, the reason it stuck.

one place for your thoughts and what you've learnt. plain text files on your own computer — yours, searchable, never locked inside someone's app. the second brain i run fomties, and the rest of my life, out of.

systems.ask: struggling with something you suspect everyone else is too? tell me. that's usually where the next one comes from.

spaces.title: spaces
spaces.intro: the conversations were never meant to stay on a screen. spaces is the in-person side — a room of twenty-somethings who are figuring it out and okay saying so. small dinners, walks, the occasional venue someone lends us. still being built. if you're early, you help shape it.

rules.v: not a discord with ten thousand people watching. a room where everyone talks.
same rule as the conversations. the real version, or don't bother.
no followers, no startup, no finished anything. a story and the willingness to tell it.

spaces.venue: got a room, a rooftop, a cafe after hours? that's how the early ones get made. say so on the form.
